no engine speed signal detected from Data Bus On Board Diagnostic Interface via CAN;\L\S\K\A\I 6\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IECON\L\S\K\I - ECON-operation;\L\S\K\A\I 7\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IA/C system OFF\L\S\K\I - Blower switch in position 0;\L\S\K\A\I 8\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IOutside temperature\L\S\K\I - Outside temperature too low, Outside temperature < 2.0 °C hysteresis up to outside temperature > 3.5 °C;\L\S\K\A\I 10\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IInsufficient voltage\L\S\K\I - Vehicle voltage supply too low, threshold depending on engine idle: Engine is running - vehicle voltage supply < 10.1 V, Engine is standing still, outside temperature > 0 °C - vehicle voltage supply< 8.7 V, Engine is standing still, outside temperature < 0 °C - vehicle voltage supply< (8.7 V - 100 mV/ 2.5 K);\L\S\K\A\I 12\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IEngine Control Module (ECM) shut-off via CAN\L\S\K\I - Reason for example engine temperature, coolant fan control module, Kick-Down;\L\S\K\A\I 13\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IExcessive voltage\L\S\K\I - Vehicle voltage supply too high, vehicle voltage supply> 16 V;\L\S\K\A\I 14\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IEvaporator temperature risk of icing\L\S\K\I - Evaporator temperature too low, Evaporator temperature < -2.0 °C hysteresis up to evaporator temperature > 0 °C;\L\S\K\A\I 16\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\ICompressor activation\L\S\K\I - Malfunction in activation path, i.e. open circuit/short circuit to B+;\L\S\K\A\I 17\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IPressure sensor\L\S\K\I - no or implausible signal from pressure sensor (PWM signal);\L\S\K\A\I 18\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IShut-off via engine speed at idle\L\S\K\I - Engine speed> 3000 RPM and speed (v) = 0 km/h;\L\S\K\A\I 19\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IShut-off from Vehicle Electrical System Control Module via CAN\L\S\K\I;\L\S\K\A\I 20\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IRefrigerant loss\L\S\K\I - (not for VR 6 engine);\L\S\K\A\I 23\L\S\K\I - \L\B\K\IShut-off due to missing coolant fan signal\L\S\K\I - Danger of excessive pressure/ high compressor load (implementation is optional)
